subject: Dedicated demo request — Horizon AI

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-24T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Dedicated demo request — Horizon AI

Hi Sam,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood — I saw your self-serve request come through and wanted to introduce myself. I work on the sales team and will coordinate a short Dedicated-capacity demo to walk through throughput/latency characteristics and how our Dedicated offering could map to your workload.

Quick questions to help scope the session:
- Target sustained throughput (tokens/s or requests/s) and typical sequence length?
- P99 latency target and concurrency (how many concurrent users/streams)?
- Any compliance or VPC/access constraints we should be aware of?

I can put 30–45 mins on the calendar this week. Are you available:
- Thu Feb 25, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu Feb 25, 15:00–15:45 PT
- Fri Feb 26, 09:00–09:45 PT

If those don't work, feel free to pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-dedicated-demo?utm_source=horizonai

Looping in Marissa (solutions) so she can tune the demo to your perf targets.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: none]

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@horizonai.com>

Date: 2027-02-25T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated demo request — Horizon AI

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks for reaching out — happy to coordinate. A bit about our workload to help scope the demo:
- Typical sequence length: ~1k tokens for RAG responses (docs + prompt)
- Expected sustained throughput during peak: ~200 requests/min (~3.3 req/s)
- Concurrency: up to 25 concurrent sessions for our public-facing product
- P99 latency target: <= 450 ms for 1k-token responses (we realize this may require model/quantization tradeoffs)

We have a short spreadsheet with additional perf targets and payload sizes — attaching.

Preferred demo times: Thu Feb 25 15:00–15:45 PT works for us.

Thanks,
Sam Lee
Head of Platform | Horizon AI
sam.lee@horizonai.com

[Attachment: HorizonAI_Throughput_requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Hi Sam — thanks for the details and for confirming Thu 15:00 PT. I've penciled you in for a 30-minute session (15:00–15:30 PT) and added Dev from our serving/runtime team to cover latency, batching, and kernel/quantization tradeoffs.

Agenda (30 mins):
- 5m: intros + desired outcomes
- 10m: Dedicated architecture & how we achieve predictable throughput/latency (autoscaling, batching, KV cache)
- 10m: Live perf discussion — review your spreadsheet + run through expected latency curves and possible quantization options
- 5m: Next steps & trial/POC checklist

Pre-demo ask: could you fill the quick questionnaire attached (it helps us prepare realistic load patterns) and share any sample request/response sizes (or a short trace) if possible. That will let Dev configure a demo that mirrors your workload.

Calendar invite: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-dedicated-demo?utm_source=horizonai

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

[Attachment: pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]
